input.summary: Add Licensee right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid fees
input.comment: [Playbook] Article IV commits us to a 36-month term with no ability to exit for convenience, while Licensor may terminate immediately on any breach. We have added our standard right to terminate on thirty (30) days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination penalty; if helpful we can move to 60 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: IV Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, without penalty, early-termination fee or other liability, in which case Licensor shall refund to Licensee any prepaid fees allocable to the period after the effective date of such termination.
